packages.headline: How The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Builds a Tactical Brawler

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
A deep dive on character design with pro tips on gameplay in The Walking Dead.
How The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Builds a Tactical Brawler
Hello everyone. The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival is available now on Xbox Series X|S and PC, and rather than walk you through a feature list, I wanted to talk about the decisions that went into creating it.
AMC’s “The Walking Dead” is a world defined by scarcity, tension, and the consequences of every decision. The “All Out War” arc adds another dimension to that foundation: momentum, escalation, and increasingly intense confrontations as the conflict with the Saviors grows.
Streets of Survival brings those qualities together through a blend of exploration, resource management, and arcade-inspired brawler combat. Search your surroundings, gather supplies and information, and decide how best to approach the dangers ahead. When conflict erupts, combat delivers the immediacy and intensity the story demands, while keeping every encounter grounded in a larger purpose.
You are not simply clearing rooms or fighting toward a score screen. Every confrontation moves you closer to an objective, a character, or a reckoning with the Saviors. Exploration creates tension, resources give decisions weight, and combat provides the payoff, combining into an experience built around the escalating conflict at the heart of The Walking Dead’s All Out War.
Rick, Daryl and Michonne are not three skins over one moveset. Each has a signature weapon, a separate set of animations and their own skill tree that you invest in every level, which means the same encounter requires a different strategy depending on the selected character.
Rick relies on his magnum: long-range firepower that turns every fight into an ammo-management problem. Michonne thrives in close quarters, cutting through hordes with her katana and rewarding you for staying inside the danger. Daryl uses his crossbow to thin threats from a distance before diving in to finish the rest, which makes him the most positional of the three.
The levels are tailored around the character meant to play them, creating an experience that adjusts to that character’s available weapons and abilities and giving more freedom in the design, while delivering a custom puzzle for players to solve in each situation.

packages.headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Hot Springs Scenes Reveal New Bathing Suit Skins for the Party

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
New Final Fantasy 7 Revelation footage has revealed a hot springs feature that boosts the party's health and gives them a set of new bathing suit skins.
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Hot Springs Scenes Reveal New Bathing Suit Skins for the Party
Half the fun of Square Enix's remake trilogy is allowing Cloud, Barret, Tifa, and the rest of the party to have some fun on their way to stop Sephiroth once and for all. In Rebirth , that meant spending a day at the beach , and in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, players will be able to kick their feet up, mingle, and, for some reason, balance rubber Chocobos at a collection of new hot springs.
The publisher unveiled the new gameplay feature as part of SDCC Málaga and later shared gameplay footage on social media. When the group stops at a hot spring, they'll benefit from a permanent increase to their max HP. The health bonus and moments shared between each character seem to be the real draw. The thing that might appeal to some players more than others, though, is the promise that the bathing suit outfits featured during these segments can be unlocked as skins, too.
Across all of the clips shown online today, we can see skins for Cloud, Barret, and Cid. Red XIII can relax in the hot springs, too, but considering he's not usually wearing clothes to begin with, it doesn't look like any skin he may get will change his appearance too much. Then, there's newly playable party member Vincent Valentine, who prefers to bathe in the same slick get-up he fights monsters in because he's… just that cool, I guess.
"We’re sharing a preview of some of the hot spring events revealed during our stage presentation at SDCC Málaga," director Naoki Hamaguchi said in a follow-up post on X/Twitter. "Each hot spring offers a different glimpse into the characters’ everyday lives, and the outfits featured in these events can also be unlocked as skins. Explore the world, discover hot springs, and enjoy these special moments with your companions!"
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is still months from delivering the concluding chapter of the remake trilogy, but that hasn't stopped Square Enix from unloading new details as often as it can manage. Hamaguchi has been especially keen to share, telling IGN last month that players will have an option to automatically level up their characters if they want to skip the grind. He's also said players could easily spend more than 100 hours playing through the story , even if the Platinum Trophy doesn't present much of a challenge on its own .
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation launches for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S April 8, 2027. While we wait to see how those hot springs heat things up for Cloud and company, you can see how Hamaguchi responded to players hoping for a full-disc release . You can also check out IGN's hands-on preview .

packages.headline: Physint Update: Hideo Kojima Shares New Info on His Upcoming Metal Gear Spiritual Successor

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Renowned game director Hideo Kojima revived his Koji10 podcast after a year and shared casting, story, and development updates on Physint, his upcoming next-generation action-espionage game and spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid.
Physint Update: Hideo Kojima Shares New Info on His Upcoming Metal Gear Spiritual Successor
Thanks to a summary of the 79-minute English-subtitled podcast on YouTube by X user Genki_JPN, we now know a bit more about the status of Physint, which made huge headlines recently after Kojima revealed that Sony was set to cancel the project as its publisher, leading to Microsoft picking it up . Kojima describes Physint as a project to commemorate his 40th anniversary as a game developer. He said he wants it to evoke the roots of the Metal Gear Solid games, but be a new interactive experience with a different kind of spy action. He aims to fill it with lots of new ideas.
The other game Kojima is developing for Microsoft, the PT spiritual successor OD, is expected to be released before Physint, which Kojima himself said was 5-6 years away last year.
Story and cast-wise, Kojima says he has the plot already and that he pitched all of the actors appearing in it himself – 70% of whom are apparently Kojima fans. Many of the character names have been decided Filming will start next year, with Bill Skarsgard , Charlie Fraser and Minami Hamabe already scanned.
Finally, the 63-year-old Kojima said that he makes every one of his games as if it could be his last.

サバイバルホラーゲーム『The Outlast Trials』が現在大きな人気を獲得している。PCおよびコンソール向けに配信されている本作にて、Steamだけでも約10万人のプレイヤーが集っている。
『The Outlast Trials』は『Outlast』シリーズの協力型サバイバルホラーゲームだ。『Outlast』『Outlast 2』を手がけたRed Barrelsが開発している。舞台は冷戦下の1959年。マーコフ社の秘密施設へと監禁されたプレイヤーたちは、強制的に人体実験の被験者となってしまう。与えられる治験（ミッション）を乗り越えて実験から解放されることを目指す。ステージには敵が徘徊しており、“本家”シリーズ同様の逃げ隠れも要求される。最大4人でのオンラインマルチプレイに対応するほか、ソロでもプレイ可能だ。
そんな本作のSteamにおける同時接続プレイヤー数が急増している。これまでの過去最高記録はリリース時の3万6689人だったところ、今月初頭から数字を伸ばし、9万45507人まで急伸している（ SteamDB ）。この要因としては、現在Steamで開催されているオータムセールがあるようだ。『The Outlast Trials』には90％オフという過去最高の割引率が設定されており、定価が税込4500円のところ、10月9日までは税込450円で購入可能。本作向けの各種コスメティックDLCも最大90％オフとなっている。セールが人を呼び、賑わいを見せているかたちだろう。
ちなみにナンバリングタイトルである『 Outlast 』および『 Outlast 2 』についても、Steamでは75％のセールが適用されているため、シリーズ作品に触れていないプレイヤーはこの機会に購入して遊んでみるにはいい機会かもしれない。

Publisher Playtonic Friends and developer Castle Pixel have released the “Bandits & Bounties” update for cowboy life simulation game Cattle Country , which introduces bounty hunting, bandit camps, and random store robberies, as well as new crafting equipment, expanded inventory space, new outfits and accessories, a new fishing destination, and more.
The update introduces new ways for players to encounter and take on the more dangerous side of frontier life. Players can pick up Wanted Posters from the Sheriff’s building and track down wanted outlaws across the wilderness, while new Bandit Camps can appear as players explore the overworld.
For those who prefer their trouble a little closer to home, bandits can now launch random robberies and shootouts at the General Store, Butcher, Carpenter and Bank, putting players in the middle of unexpected encounters as they go about their daily lives.
But “Bandits & Bounties” isn’t all about outlaws. The update also expands the ways players can build, craft, customize, and explore Cattle Country , adding new equipment including the Toolbelt, Extra Large Bag, Animal Trap, Rock Tumbler and Tailoring Table.
There’s a new way to earn your keep around these parts.
Keep an eye out for Wanted Posters at the Sheriff’s building. Pick up a bounty and head out into the wilderness to track down the wanted bandit. Find your target, take them down and head back to Sheriff Tom to claim your reward.
But you’d best keep your wits about you out there. Bandit camps can now appear as you explore the overworld, giving you the chance to clean up the West and maybe even claim some plunder for your trouble.

From the creators of Edge: A free weekly videogame industry newsletter, featuring in-depth news, expert analysis and exclusive interviews
From the creators of Edge: A weekly videogame industry newsletter with analysis from expert writers, guidance from professionals, and insight into what's on the horizon.
Industry layoff watch: Supermassive, Ninja Theory, The Coalition, and a warning from Warhorse
The plague of games industry layoffs and studio closures that seemed to explode in 2023 has yet to subside. Just about every week there's news of some new restructuring, closure, or cancellation as the videogame industry, particularly in North America, is battered by global economic forces, corporate maneuvering, and private capital.
It speaks to the current state of the game industry that some developers on Gears of War: E-Day are not looking forward to basking in the successful launch of their game, or even the ongoing responsibilities of post-launch support, but are instead worrying about the possibility of being laid off. Multiple sources at the studio told Eurogamer that confidence in The Coalition's stability as the home of Gears of War has given way to trepidation as Microsoft has repeatedly demonstrated that no one is safe.
That's not an entirely new or original sentiment, and as PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens noted at the time, it's potentially good news for devs in those parts of the world, at least until the vagaries of capitalism catches up. But it's far less upbeat for industry workers in North America already facing pressure from rising costs, generative AI, and bottom-line-obsessed shareholders.
Andy has been gaming on PCs from the very beginning, starting as a youngster with text adventures and primitive action games on a cassette-based TRS80. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. He covers all aspects of the industry, from new game announcements and patch notes to legal disputes, Twitch beefs, esports, and Henry Cavill. Lots of Henry Cavill.

packages.headline: 'It’s Incredibly Sad Knowing That We Won’t Get to Finish What We Were Working on' — Hellblade Staff Bid Farewell to Ninja Theory as Layoffs Begin

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
After Xbox announced its intention to close Hellblade developer Ninja Theory, staff have started saying their farewells as layoffs begin.
'It’s Incredibly Sad Knowing That We Won’t Get to Finish What We Were Working on' — Hellblade Staff Bid Farewell to Ninja Theory as Layoffs Begin
Last month, Xbox announced its intention to close Hellblade developer Ninja Theory , after two deals to save the company didn’t pan out. Now we’re starting to see the consequences of that decision as people at the studio post on job site LinkedIn, spotted by journalist Chris Kerr .
“What I’ll remember most is how much people cared. About the work, about the details, and about each other. I feel very lucky that this was the place where I got to start my career and grow into the programmer I am today. It’s incredibly sad knowing that we won’t get to finish what we were working on. So much care, talent and effort went into it, and I really wish we’d had the chance to see what it could have become.”
Expert technical sound designer Alessio Mellina is also at risk of redundancy after 12 years with the studio working on the industry-leading binaural audio that powered Hellblade ’s haunting whispers. “As the only Technical Sound Designer here, I've been the owner of most of our dynamic audio systems on recent projects,” he said.
Performance capture expert Xoe Suvari has also been let go. “Hundreds of shoot days,” he said. “Hours and hours of data. Sweat and bruises from set builds. New pipelines and the never ending battle of naming conventions. I saw my team grow at work and as people, and together we built a performance capture stage that was truly top of its class.”
All of the posts talk about their colleagues, suggesting layoffs are widespread throughout the studio. In June, at an Xbox Games Showcase event, Microsoft announced Senua , the third game in the Hellblade series. It’s widely speculated that the trailer was intended to increase interest with potential buyers of Ninja Theory, since Microsoft would have known at this point that it had no plans to publish the title.
Last month, Microsoft announced that the next mainline Halo game will be developed by Call of Duty maker Activision , with mass layoffs hitting Halo Studios. Xbox has moved Age of Empires developer World's Edge and Sea of Thieves developer Rare under the Activision umbrella.
Numerous team members depart following Xbox cuts.
“I’ve been trying to figure out how to write this because Ninja Theory was never just a job to me,” gameplay programmer Katrin Mair said. “After four years, it’s hard to put into words how much this place and the people in it have meant to me.

While many of the original developers at Platinum have left — including original game director Hideki Kamiya, who started a new studio called Clovers to make Okami 2 — the Osaka-based studio wants to keep the series going.
As well as Kamiya, other notable leavers include Resident Evil character designer Masaki Yamanaka, Metal Gear Rising director Kenji Saito, and Astral Chain director Takahisa Taura. Bayonetta 2 director Yusuke Hashimoto left Platinum to work at Capcom, where he recently helped the combat shine in Onimusha: Way of the Sword.
Even outside of the exodus, things aren’t as simple as just making another one. The Bayonetta series is co-owned by Sega and Nintendo, who published the first and second games respectively. The sequel was a Nintendo Wii U exclusive and has since only been ported to Nintendo Switch. Bayonetta 3 came to Switch in 2022.
In an interview with Famitsu , via VGC , Inaba spoke for the first time about PlatinumGames’ aims since the departure of key staff members. When asked about the future of Bayonetta, he said: “I can’t really answer that right now.
“We have a strong desire to further develop the character of Bayonetta and expand her world. Please look forward to seeing what form that takes in the future.”
The interview was a promotional partnership between Inaba and Shift-Up boss Hyung-tae Kim, to promote Stellar Blade ’s Bayonetta crossover event on Nintendo Switch 2. PlatinumGames' last released game is Ninja Gaiden 4 , a collaboration with Team Ninja which launched on October 21, 2025, for PS5, Xbox Series consoles, and PC.
Next up, PlatinumGames is working on Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin , an action-adventure game based on a popular comic. A partnership with Paramount, the game was announced at Summer Game Fest in June 2026 after the original version by Black Forest Games was canceled.

『キングダム ハーツ コレクション [I～III]』は、ディズニーおよびスクウェア・エニックスが手がける『キングダム ハーツ』の主要タイトルを収録した『キングダム ハーツ – HD 1.5+2.5 リミックス -』、『キングダム ハーツ HD 2.8 ファイナル チャプター プロローグ』、『キングダム ハーツ III ＋ リマインド』がひとつになったセットである。10月8日発売予定で、対応プラットフォームはNintendo Switch 2/PS5/XBOX Series X|S/XBOX on PC。なお、『KINGDOM HEARTS INTEGRUM MASTERPIECE』としてPC（Steam）版が発売中だ。

『キングダム ハーツ』シリーズを青春期から夢中になってプレイしてきた筆者が、このたび『キングダム ハーツ コレクション [I～III]』のコラムを執筆する機会に恵まれた。数ある収録タイトルの中で、今回筆者が執筆に選んだのは『キングダム ハーツII -ファイナルミックス-』とHD映像作品の『キングダムハーツ 358/2 Days』である。なぜこの2作品なのか。その理由はシンプルだ。実は筆者が『キングダム ハーツ』シリーズで初めて触れたタイトルは、ニンテンドーDS版の『キングダム ハーツ 358/2 Days』であった。シリーズ主人公のソラではなくロクサスが主人公となる同作を、いわゆる「パケ買い」で購入し、『キングダム ハーツ』シリーズの知識がない状態でプレイした。疑問や不安を抱えながらも、自分の意思で真実へと向かっていくロクサスの姿に心をつかまれたのを覚えている。そのため筆者にとってロクサスの存在は今でも大きい。
そんなロクサスに久しぶりに会いたくなり、自然と彼が登場するこの二作品を選んでいた。またプレイした後でも、大人になった筆者が『キングダム ハーツ』と再会するにあたって、あえてこの2作品から始めてよかったと思える。本稿では、『キングダム ハーツII -ファイナルミックス-』とHD映像作品の『キングダム ハーツ 358/2 Days』を通して、筆者が大人になって気づいた両作の魅力、そして忘れてしまったことを再び取り戻していく様子をお届けする。
『キングダム ハーツ』シリーズは、伝説の武器「キーブレード」に選ばれた主人公のソラが、ドナルドやグーフィーをはじめとした仲間とともに、ディズニーやピクサーのワールドを巡り、世界の闇へと立ち向かっていく物語である。光と闇、そして心が大きなテーマとして描かれ、その深部にある謎に包まれたストーリーも展開される。

sources.evidenceText:

『鉄拳8』にて“目隠しプレイ”で破壊神になった猛者現る。聴くだけで“見える”『鉄拳』やり込みすぎプロ
バンダイナムコエンターテインメントが販売する『 鉄拳8（TEKKEN 8） 』にて、プロプレイヤーSuperBrine氏が目隠しで上位ランクの「破壊神」に到達したことが話題となっている。 IGN が報じており、同氏に取材を実施している。
『鉄拳8』は、3D対戦格闘ゲーム『鉄拳』シリーズの最新作だ。PC（Steam）/PS5/Xbox Series X|S 向けに2024年1月に発売された。本作ではバトルコンセプトのキーワードとして「Aggressive（アグレッシブ）」が掲げられ、キャラクター個々の特性が強化されるヒートシステムや攻めれば体力が回復する回復可能ゲージなどが導入され、攻めることを重視したゲームシステムとなっている。
また、SuperBrine氏は、エジプトを拠点に活動する『鉄拳8』のプロプレイヤー。アリサをメインキャラクターとしており、2026年には「TEKKEN World Tour 2026」関連の地域大会で複数回優勝するなど実績を残している。
そんなSuperBrine氏が“目隠し”にてランクマッチに挑戦したことが話題となっている。同氏は睡眠用のアイマスクを付けた状態で『鉄拳8』をプレイ。得意キャラのアリサで6月から挑戦を開始し、全8回の挑戦を経て、一番下の「入門生」から最上位ランクである「破壊神」に到達した。執筆時点では同氏のTwitchにて配信のダイジェストを確認できる。
ちなみに『鉄拳8』にはサウンド面のアクセシビリティ機能は存在しない。たとえば『ストリートファイター6』では、視覚情報に頼りにくいプレイヤー向けのアクセシビリティ機能が存在する。相手との距離をビープ音の高さによって示したり、ゲージの残量などを効果音で知らせたりといった機能がある。
一方の『鉄拳8』には、そういった機能は存在しないものの、音からもある程度の情報を得ることができる。IGNの取材に対し、SuperBrine氏は音を瞬時に聞き分け、壁やられが起こったのか、ヒットなのかブロックなのか、またヒットしたならそれはカウンターヒットなのか通常のヒットなのかなどを判断していると説明している。さらに、ランク帯ごとにどんなコンボが有効かそうでないかなどを見極めているといい、本作についての豊富な経験が成す所業であるようだ。

packages.headline: Arc Raiders and The Finals Are Getting Adapted Into Films and TV Shows

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Hollywood is mining Arc Raiders and The Finals for its next big video game adaptations, as the two franchises will be turned into films and TV shows.
Arc Raiders and The Finals Are Getting Adapted Into Films and TV Shows
Per Variety , Nexon, the parent company of developer Embark Studios, will team up with a production company known as Chernin Entertainment to develop adaptations of Arc Raiders and The Finals. As of right now, it sounds like the teams are exploring all possible options, which include TV shows and films. This will be done to help expand the worlds of these games that "reward the passion" of the players, according to Nexon.
“ARC Raiders and The Finals are exactly the kind of opportunities we’ve been building towards at Chernin Entertainment: ambitious global IP with the potential to become major franchises across film and television,” said David Ready, president of film at Chernin Entertainment. “Nexon and Embark have created visually stunning, atmospheric worlds that contain countless stories to tell. We’re honored they’ve trusted us to unite our film and television teams to tell those stories.”
Embark Studios says it will work directly with Chernin Entertainment to develop these adaptations, ensuring there is respect paid to the worlds and lore that fans have fallen in love with over the years. As of right now, there are no release dates or specifics for these projects, so they are likely still years away from materializing.
Arc Raiders was one of the biggest games of 2025, but it has lost some steam in recent months due to a lack of steady updates with significant content. Later this month, Embark plans to test a PvE mode in the game , allowing players to enjoy a more cooperative experience without fear of being gunned down by other players. The studio emphasized that there's no guarantee that this mode will become permanent, but it is exploring the option following demand from players.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

packages.headline: Dungeons and Dragons: World of Warcraft – Everything You Need to Know

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Dungeons and Dragons: World of Warcraft was announced way back in July, as the first Universes Beyond release for the storied tabletop RPG. And just like the MMO it's based on, D&D: World of Warcraft is absolutely massive.
Dungeons and Dragons: World of Warcraft – Everything You Need to Know
But while this was the first Universes Beyond release for D&D, it’s nothing new for Wizards of the Coast, with the initiative driving a huge number of Magic: The Gathering sets over the last few years. But just like the scope of the Lord of the Rings set for MTG, Dungeons and Dragons: World of Warcraft is an absolutely massive expansion, and almost feels like an entire game unto itself.
Rather than just taking the easy way out and releasing a one-off story module, Wizards of the Coast packed its World of Warcraft expansion with enough lore, dungeons, and professions that it could feasibly take you years to try everything. But, unlike WoW on your desktop, you can choose exactly how your Azeroth story will play out.
World of Warcraft has been around for 22 years on its own, and the franchise as a whole has been around since 1994. Needless to say, there is a ton of lore and history baked into the world of Azeroth. And, a huge portion of it is built into D&D: World of Warcraft.
The entire world of Azeroth is described in the book, up to The War Within. And, just like the game, each zone has a rough level range that Wizards had in mind when designing them. As Game Designer Joey Haeck says, “WoW has a starting zone for Orcs in Durotar, so it makes sense for that to be a level 1-4 zone in D&D.” Likewise, endgame zones like Northrend (at least zones that used to be endgame zones) will be designed with high-level characters in mind.
Though, this is D&D, so it’s entirely possible to just shrug off these suggestions and build your own campaign the way you want to. Haeck says, “as usual, with D&D, the power is in your hands.”
However, the expansion is focused entirely on the planet of Azeroth itself. So you won’t find the likes of Argus, the Shadowlands or Draenor here, though you can rely on your own knowledge of those worlds. Luckily, Shadowlands and Warlords of Draenor are two of the most maligned WoW expansions in history, so I’m sure a lot of people won’t miss them too much. It does mean, though, that you might have to get creative to do a campaign in The Burning Crusade’s Outland – which is just a blown-up Draenor.

packages.headline: Fortnite Has Updated In-Game Art After Fans Discovered a Google Gemini AI Image Watermark

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Fortnite has quietly replaced a piece of in-game artwork after fans spotted its original version contained a Google Gemini AI watermark.
Fortnite Has Updated In-Game Art After Fans Discovered a Google Gemini AI Image Watermark
Epic Games added the music track "Meow" by Ironmouse, Sleeping Forest & HalaCG to Fortnite last month, with the telltale Gemini watermark in the track artwork's bottom right corner. This lay mostly unnoticed until last weekend, when its wider discovery prompted something of a minor kerfuffle on social media and Reddit .
As of this morning, however, this artwork has been replaced with an alternate version (with no Gemini watermark). But after closer inspection, it's worth pointing out that the Gemini usage was present in the track list's original art that Epic Games simply incorporated in-game. Go check the track on Spotify, and the Gemini mark is there, too. In other words, the Gemini usage here is the fault of whoever made the track art initially — not Epic Games.
So, why the switcheroo? AI-generated artwork in Fortnite is a contentious subject for fans who have pointed to previous dubious examples such as an in-game poster featuring a nine-toed character in a hammock to suggest that Epic Games was resorting to poor-quality AI work rather than using human designers. A more recent, official developer video then pulled back the curtain on Epic Games' AI use, showcasing how the company experiments with AI in the conceptual phase when creating characters and in-game locations .
All of that said, Epic Games has always shied away from strictly confirming any particular in-game art is AI generated, and has maintained at least a veneer of quality over the evergreen battle royale it continually toils to keep popular. To date, there hasn't been anything quite as egregious as Call of Duty's embarrassing and grotesque six-fingered Santa .
The fact that Epic Games has made the switch here is, if anything, a positive sign that it does not want to openly show artwork featuring obvious AI elements, such as that Gemini watermark, in Fortnite.
Meanwhile, over the weekend, Disney stated that its rumored desire to buy Epic Games was not something it was planning to act on — at least right now.
